design_commit: feature/issue-398 (the #398 receive split: the data lane on the adopted supply-referenced aib_rx_data, the two clock lanes on aib_rx_inv, the committed inverter receiver aib_rx_clk instantiates in both legs; tb_t16.cir wires the clock pair through lane_clk)
claim_scope: CH only (declared channel model spec/channel/channel_rc.cir, CH-3MM-RC nominal); the L2 wire-bond loopback does not observe RX-input skew and no TC value is recorded here
bench: tb_t16.cir: lane A rises and the center-aligned clock pair (rxc - rxcb) rises 500 ps later; graded quantity is the data-to-clock delay minus the nominal 0.5 UI
skew_definition: signed difference, limits +-bound, target_sigma 7 each side (sim/mc/README.md, Assumptions for ratification). This measurement is at the RX PINS, not the receiver outputs; the receiver-output two-edge timing disposition for the split is recorded separately in design/README.md from the clock-path record (sim/clock-path/records/20261123T091724Z/), and a passing T-16 here does not by itself establish receiver-output margin

sample_size.basis: re-run of the 2026-11-20 campaign (#385) at its recorded sample counts (40 per corner, set by the 2026-11-10 run's 20-draw pilot verdict of 1318) on the #398 split cells

result.tail: worst draw -15.1 ps against the -30 limit; zero draws outside +-30 ps
result.negative_control_basis: every degraded draw fails: control yield 0.0 of 900 (control seed 4421), against nominal 1.0

note: T-16 PASSES the 7-sigma gate on the #398 split: pooled mean -0.3 ps, sigma 3.4 ps, sigma-to-spec 8.7 with lower bound 8.4 against 7; no draw outside +-30 ps, worst -15.1 ps. Against the 2026-11-20 record (mean -0.7 ps, sigma 3.4 ps) the RX-pin row is unchanged by the adoption, matching the #386 study's t16-mixed leg. Supersedes 20261120T202400Z-t16, which stays untouched as append-only evidence; per-corner reading in sim/mc/per_corner.md. The limits and the sigma convention are unchanged.
